series.title: One Piece
series.author: Eiichiro Oda
series.synopsis: A rubber-limbed boy sets sail with a ragtag crew to find the legendary treasure and become King of the Pirates.

series.title: Jujutsu Kaisen
series.author: Gege Akutami
series.synopsis: A high-schooler swallows a cursed finger and joins a secret school of sorcerers fighting the curses born from human fear.

series.title: Demon Slayer
series.author: Koyoharu Gotouge
series.synopsis: After demons slaughter his family, Tanjiro trains as a demon slayer to save his sister and avenge them.

series.title: Chainsaw Man
series.author: Tatsuki Fujimoto
series.synopsis: A broke devil hunter merges with his chainsaw-devil dog and is recruited into a government unit with very strange bosses.

series.title: Naruto
series.author: Masashi Kishimoto
series.synopsis: An outcast ninja with a fox spirit sealed inside him dreams of becoming the leader of his village.

series.title: Spy × Family
series.author: Tatsuya Endo
series.synopsis: A spy, an assassin and a telepathic child pretend to be a normal family — none of them knowing the others' secrets.

series.title: My Hero Academia
series.author: Kohei Horikoshi
series.synopsis: In a world where most people have superpowers, a powerless boy inherits the greatest power of all.

series.title: Attack on Titan
series.author: Hajime Isayama
series.synopsis: Humanity lives behind giant walls to hide from man-eating Titans — until the day the wall is breached.

series.title: Blue Lock
series.author: Muneyuki Kaneshiro & Yusuke Nomura
series.synopsis: Three hundred young strikers are locked in a training facility to forge the world's most selfish, game-winning forward.

series.title: Tokyo Revengers
series.author: Ken Wakui
series.synopsis: A down-on-his-luck man is thrown twelve years into the past and must climb a biker gang to save the girl he loved.

series.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
series.author: Kanehito Yamada & Tsukasa Abe
series.synopsis: After the hero's party defeats the Demon King, their elf mage sets out to understand the humans she outlived.

series.title: Detective Conan
series.author: Gosho Aoyama
series.synopsis: A teenage detective is shrunk into a child's body and keeps solving cases while hunting the syndicate that poisoned him.

series.title: Fullmetal Alchemist
series.author: Hiromu Arakawa
series.synopsis: Two brothers pay a terrible price for a forbidden alchemy experiment and search for the Philosopher's Stone to restore their bodies.

series.title: Soul Eater
series.author: Atsushi Ohkubo
series.synopsis: At a school for weapon-meisters, a girl and her scythe partner hunt corrupted souls to forge a weapon for Death himself.
